text.en: A searchable guitar-chord reference that connects symbols and formulas to playable fretboard voicings.
text.zhTW: 可搜尋的吉他和弦參考工具，將和弦符號與公式連結到可彈奏的指板配置。

text.en: Chord Dictionary lets a visitor choose or search for a chord, inspect its symbol, formula, and notes, hear it, and browse generated guitar shapes. The current page also filters shapes by fret area, root string, and string set.
text.zhTW: 和弦字典讓訪客選擇或搜尋和弦、查看符號、公式與音名、聆聽聲音，並瀏覽產生的吉他指型。目前頁面也可依琴格區域、根音弦與弦組篩選指型。

text.en: The implementation brings theoretical chord identity and practical guitar fingering into one lookup flow instead of separating formula reference from playable shapes.
text.zhTW: 從實作可回溯看出，此工具把和弦理論身分與實際吉他按法放在同一查詢流程，而非將公式參考與可彈指型分開。

text.en: Browse by root and chord quality, or type a chord symbol, then compare voicings in standard E A D G B E tuning.
text.zhTW: 依根音與和弦種類瀏覽，或輸入和弦符號，再比較標準 E A D G B E 調弦下的各種配置。

text.en: The June 25 launch added a dedicated chord reference alongside the site's existing tracks, progressions, Key Finder, and Scale Explorer tools.
text.zhTW: 6 月 25 日推出時，它在既有音軌、和弦進行、調性偵測器與音階探索器旁新增一個獨立和弦參考工具。

text.en: Commit a901651 introduced the dedicated HTML page, a 572-line interaction script, and a 559-line page stylesheet in one change.
text.zhTW: Commit a901651 在同一變更中加入獨立 HTML 頁面、572 行互動腳本與 559 行頁面樣式。

text.en: Twelve root-note controls and categorized chord-quality browsing.
text.zhTW: 十二個根音控制與依類別整理的和弦種類瀏覽。

text.en: Text filtering, selected-chord symbol, interval formula, spelled notes, and Web Audio playback.
text.zhTW: 文字篩選、所選和弦符號、音程公式、音名拼寫與 Web Audio 播放。

text.en: Generated guitar voicings, diagrams, shape counts, and pagination in standard tuning.
text.zhTW: 以標準調弦產生吉他配置、圖表、指型數量與分頁。

text.en: Heading and tagline → two-column workspace → root/search browser → selected-chord detail → facts → shape grid and pagination.
text.zhTW: 標題與標語 → 雙欄工作區 → 根音／搜尋瀏覽器 → 所選和弦詳細資訊 → 基本資料 → 指型網格與分頁。

text.en: The browser and detail regions collapsed from two columns at 1120px; additional grid reductions were defined at 680px and 420px.
text.zhTW: 瀏覽器與詳細資訊區在 1120px 以下由雙欄收合，並在 680px 與 420px 進一步縮減網格。

text.en: The page reads as a browse-and-inspect workspace: selection stays on the left while the resulting musical and fingering detail stays on the right at wide widths.
text.zhTW: 從實作回溯可見，頁面採用「瀏覽並檢視」工作區：寬螢幕時左側保留選擇，右側呈現音樂與指法結果。

text.en: Root buttons, symbol/type search, and chord categories provide both directed selection and text lookup.
text.zhTW: 根音按鈕、符號／種類搜尋與和弦分類，同時支援直接選擇與文字查詢。

text.en: The selected chord exposes its readable name, symbol, formula, spelled notes, description, and a play control before shape browsing.
text.zhTW: 在瀏覽指型前，所選和弦會顯示易讀名稱、符號、公式、音名、說明與播放控制。

text.en: Position, root-string, and string-set controls narrow the generated voicing collection without changing the selected chord.
text.zhTW: 位置、根音弦與弦組控制可縮小產生的配置集合，而不改變所選和弦。

text.en: Current related-tool actions connect a chosen chord to other public music tools.
text.zhTW: 目前的相關工具操作會把所選和弦連到其他公開音樂工具。

text.en: chord-dictionary.html provides semantic regions, controls, empty render hosts, navigation, localization hooks, and public metadata.
text.zhTW: chord-dictionary.html 提供語意區域、控制項、空白渲染容器、導覽、在地化掛鉤與公開中繼資料。

text.en: The Vue frontend owns chord taxonomy, symbol parsing, note spelling, voicing generation and scoring, filters, diagram rendering, pagination, and playback.
text.zhTW: Vue 前端管理和弦分類、符號解析、音名拼寫、配置產生與評分、篩選、圖表渲染、分頁與播放。

text.en: scripts/chord-shapes.js later extracted reusable chord parsing, voicing, and diagram models used by Song Workspace and Progression Writer; Chord Dictionary retains its richer page-specific interaction layer.
text.zhTW: scripts/chord-shapes.js 後來抽出可供歌曲工作區與和弦進行編寫器重用的和弦解析、配置與圖表模型；和弦字典仍保留更完整的頁面專屬互動層。

text.en: styles/chord-dictionary.css owns the two-column workspace, filters, diagrams, tone families, light/dark variants, and responsive breakpoints; shared base, component, theme, navigation, animation, and i18n files supply site-wide behavior.
text.zhTW: styles/chord-dictionary.css 管理雙欄工作區、篩選、圖表、音程色系、明暗變體與響應式斷點；共用基礎、元件、主題、導覽、動畫與 i18n 檔案提供全站行為。

text.en: A browser/detail grid gives the generated shapes more width than the selection panel, with multi-column chord and shape grids.
text.zhTW: 瀏覽器／詳細資訊網格讓產生的指型區比選擇面板更寬，並使用多欄和弦與指型網格。

text.en: At 1120px the workspace becomes one column and chord-quality controls gain more columns, preserving scanning space before mobile compression.
text.zhTW: 在 1120px 時工作區改為單欄，和弦種類控制增加欄數，在進入行動版壓縮前保留掃讀空間。

text.en: Below 680px headings stack, root/quality/fact/shape grids reduce columns, filters stay wrapping, and below 420px the narrow controls simplify further.
text.zhTW: 680px 以下標題堆疊，根音／種類／資料／指型網格縮減欄數，篩選可換行；420px 以下再簡化窄版控制。

text.en: The first version already combined browsing, theory facts, audio, generated diagrams, and pagination.
text.zhTW: 初版已結合瀏覽、理論資料、音訊、產生式圖表與分頁。

text.en: A second same-day change added fret-area filters and enlarged diagram labels for more legible shape comparison.
text.zhTW: 同日第二項變更加入琴格區域篩選，並放大圖表標示以便比較指型。

text.en: Chord-symbol search wording, root-string filters, string-set filters, larger tone labels, and light-theme diagram variables were added.
text.zhTW: 新增和弦符號搜尋文字、根音弦篩選、弦組篩選、更大的音程標示與淺色主題圖表變數。

text.en: The page script moved under scripts/, while shared components and themes expanded; the product behavior remained a dedicated static page.
text.zhTW: 頁面腳本移至 scripts/，共用元件與主題擴充；產品行為仍維持獨立靜態頁面。

text.en: Page chrome, dynamic chord copy, controls, and accessibility labels gained localization hooks and bilingual dictionaries.
text.zhTW: 頁面介面、動態和弦文字、控制與無障礙標籤加入在地化掛鉤與雙語字典。

title.en: Chord shapes become a shared product system
title.zhTW: 和弦指型成為共用產品系統

text.en: Song Workspace introduced scripts/chord-shapes.js so chord parsing and diagram models could be reused across products.
text.zhTW: 歌曲工作區引入 scripts/chord-shapes.js，使和弦解析與圖表模型能跨產品重用。

text.en: Chord Dictionary joined the completed v2.0.5 Vue migration while retaining its reference, filtering, diagram, and playback behavior.
text.zhTW: 和弦字典納入 v2.0.5 完成的 Vue 遷移，同時保留參考、篩選、圖表與播放行為。

title.en: Generated voicings over a fixed catalog
title.zhTW: 產生式配置而非固定目錄

text.en: The scoring and search code favors breadth across roots and qualities, but requires clear constraints, filters, and pagination to keep many valid shapes understandable.
text.zhTW: 從評分與搜尋程式回溯可見，此方式優先涵蓋多種根音與種類，但也需要清楚限制、篩選與分頁，才能讓大量有效指型易於理解。

title.en: Theory and fingering in one page

text.en: Keeping formula, notes, playback, and shapes together reduces navigation, while making the responsive stacking order and visual hierarchy more important.
text.zhTW: 將公式、音名、播放與指型放在一起可減少導覽，但也讓響應式堆疊順序與視覺層級更重要。

title.zhTW: 頁面深度搭配共用基礎

text.en: The later shared renderer supports reuse without flattening the richer browsing workflow unique to Chord Dictionary.
text.zhTW: 後來的共用渲染器支援重用，同時沒有削弱和弦字典獨有的深度瀏覽流程。

text.en: Mobile chord-tool layout corrections landed on July 28 as part of a focused shared responsive fix.
text.zhTW: 7 月 28 日的共用響應式修正包含行動版和弦工具版面調整。

text.en: A site-wide typography normalization changed Chord Dictionary markup on August 30 and was explicitly reversed later the same day; the current page uses the restored pre-normalization treatment.
text.zhTW: 8 月 30 日全站字體正規化曾修改和弦字典標記，並於同日明確回復；目前頁面使用回復後的原字體處理。

text.en: Chord Dictionary is a Vue-owned public page at /chord-dictionary.html with English and Traditional Chinese, light/dark themes, symbol lookup, generated voicings, multiple shape filters, audio playback, responsive layouts, shared navigation, and links into related tools.
text.zhTW: 和弦字典目前是由 Vue 管理、位於 /chord-dictionary.html 的公開頁面，支援英文與繁體中文、明暗主題、符號查詢、產生式配置、多重指型篩選、音訊播放、響應式版面、共用導覽與相關工具連結。

text.en: A useful musical reference can expose complexity progressively: identify the chord first, then reveal theory, then let the player narrow physical shapes.
text.zhTW: 實用的音樂參考可漸進揭露複雜度：先確認和弦，再呈現理論，最後讓演奏者縮小實際指型範圍。

text.en: Reusable chord-shape primitives became more valuable once multiple tools needed the same parsing and diagram model, but the product-specific interaction still deserved its own module.
text.zhTW: 當多個工具需要相同解析與圖表模型後，可重用的和弦指型基礎更有價值；但產品專屬互動仍值得保留獨立模組。

text.en: No original planning document, wireframe, user-research record, or documented comparison of rejected alternatives was found in the reviewed repository history.
text.zhTW: 在已檢視的儲存庫歷史中，未找到原始規劃文件、線框圖、使用者研究紀錄或被否決替代方案的書面比較。
